div.p: Same end-to-end pipeline as the equivalent figure on the qoala-mlir docs site, but with the euqalyptus frontend span highlighted (user Python → AST → MLIR Python bindings → emitted Qoala HIR). The qoala-mlir part (HIR → MIR → LIR → .iqoala) is shown collapsed/dimmed.

Specifically: boxes for (1) user Python program, (2) euqalyptus AST recording, (3) QoalaModule.generate_qoala_hir() emitting via qnet.dialects.qnet, (4) Qoala HIR (.mlir text). Then a dimmed group: qoala-opt → qoala-translate → .iqoala.
